scope:
Add `docs/adr/0016-locks-bound-product-paths.md` (233 lines) and `docs/adr/0017-bookkeeping-closeouts-do-not-inherit-risk.md` (129 lines). Both already exist verbatim in the coordinator checkout this session runs from; copy them unchanged. Do not rewrite, reformat, renumber or update them — a decision record edited after the fact misrepresents when the decision was made.

Add `tests/test_adr_references.py` binding citations to files: scan every `scripts/*.py` (and, if cheap, every `docs/**/*.md` and the root `*.md` governance files) for the pattern `ADR ####`, and assert each cited number resolves to exactly one `docs/adr/####-*.md`. The failure message must name the citing file, the cited number, and the missing path. Assert the converse is NOT required — an ADR may exist without being cited.

REPRODUCIBILITY — what this task removes, and what to change to get the same result.
  Symptom: an operator or a CCA reads `is_bookkeeping_closeout` in `scripts/mergegate_check.py`, sees it justified by 'ADR 0017' nine times, goes to `docs/adr/` and finds the numbering stops at 0015. The stated basis of the exemption that merged seven PRs with zero Guardian approvals cannot be read.
  Measured on origin/main 2026-08-04: `git cat-file -e origin/main:docs/adr/0017-bookkeeping-closeouts-do-not-inherit-risk.md` fails; so does 0016. `git merge-base --is-ancestor 9914d22 origin/main` fails — the authoring commits are unreachable from main. Meanwhile `scripts/mergegate_check.py` cites ADR 0017 nine times and `scripts/guardian_approval_signal.py` cites 0016/0017 seven times.
  Root cause: the documents were written on a coordinator branch during the work they describe, and no task ever declared `docs/adr/…` in its locks, so nothing carried them. ADR 0015 reached main only because a Contract PR carries its Goal's source plan; 0016 and 0017 had no equivalent route.
  Why it was silent: `grep -n 'docs/adr' scripts/validate_shiki.py` returns nothing. No validator requires a cited ADR to exist, so the citations and the directory drifted with no signal. This is the same unbound-pair shape behind the other silent failures this week — hence the test, not just the two files.
  Reproducible when: both files are on the default branch and the new test fails if a script cites an ADR number with no matching document.
test_command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && python3 scripts/validate_shiki.py --target .
title: Carry ADR 0016 and 0017 and bind ADR citations to their files
